capabilities: count words and characters in selected editor text
display word, character, sentence, footnote, and citation counts in the status bar
track vault totals and counts typed today
customize which stats appear in the status bar
extras: The author recommends turning off the built-in Word Count core plugin because this plugin is designed to replace it.
intentEvidence: This plugin is the same as the built-in Word Count plugin, except when you select text
problem: Obsidian's built-in word count only counts the whole document and ignores text selections, and it offers no statistics over time.
summary: Word counter that counts selected text instead of the whole document and tracks vault-wide writing statistics in a customizable status bar.
